issues.on_page: Bond principal payments (25,000); Bond interest/fee payments (11,401); Proceeds from sale of assets 2,300 (under Other financing sources (uses))
issues.issue: Debt service payments of 36,401 are printed under Other financing sources (uses), so they are recorded in other_financing and not counted as spending. This follows the as-printed rule and the arithmetic is right (137,787 + 327,807 - 225,858 + 35,313 - 105,622 - 34,101 = 135,326), but the governmental disbursements leave out the debt service.

The grantor is not printed (the Statement of Activities p2 shows only operating 31,852 / capital 16,704 grants and contributions). Under the 2026-11-06 ruling 'do not guess a grantor', state aid is an assumption. The same applies to detail[10] (General 20,000, p10) and detail[30] (Special Revenue 18,069, p11).

issues.on_page: Garbage Collection: Charges for services and refunds 30,866
issues.issue: The rules say garbage/refuse charges are Utility Charges, and Diller_FY2024 records the Garbage Collection fund's same line as Utility Charges. Here the line keeps charges for services/fees (detail_category refuse/sanitation charges).
'Deposits' is a context label (category_decisions apply=context). Diller_FY2024 records the same line as Utility Charges. The same applies to receipts[15].

issues.on_page: Capital outlay 45,653 (Special Revenue; no object printed)
issues.issue: The object is not printed, so 'equipment purchases' is a guess; 'not itemized' may fit better. The same applies to detail[48] (Park Shelter 17,795, p12).
This is sales tax paid by the utility. 'tax refunds/treasurer fees' is a near miss; the category Other Taxes Paid is fine. The same applies to detail[72] (Water 311).
